description: Zendmasten Den Haag is a dataset listed in den-haag-opendata open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by den-haag-opendata. Beschrijving: Locaties van zendmasten: masten bestemd voor het uitzenden van radio, televisie of telecommunicatie signalen. Bron: BGT gemeente Den Haag Doel registratie: Maken van de BGT Kwaliteit: Driejaarlijkse opname. Coördinatenstelsel: RDnew. De KML is WGS84. Coverage: The Hague. The portal files it under Space and infrastructure. The portal shows 8 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-05-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-den-haag-opendata-portal.
